input.value: grease fire from stovetop sauteing onions, extinguished with fire extinguisher
charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls, no damage to rest of house

input.rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and interior surfaces (ceiling/walls) is direct property damage to the insured home.

Charred cabinets and smoke damage to kitchen ceiling and walls indicate localized but meaningful damage requiring professional restoration and repairs, with no injuries and damage localized to one room. Likely in the $2,000–$25,000 range.

input.claim_summary: Fire damage claim (POL-1001) from grease flare-up on stovetop in kitchen. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls, no injuries. Estimated severity medium; damage localized to kitchen only. Policy limit $250k, deductible $500.
